mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS menu_id, m.cat_id, c.name AS cat_name, m.name, m.price, m.image_url, m.description, m.sold_out FROM menu m JOIN category c ON c.id = m.cat_id WHERE m.id = #{menuId}

SELECT ing_id AS ingId, ing_name AS name, ing_sold_out AS isSoldOut, role_id AS roleId, quantity, unit_id AS unitId, is_default AS isDefault, can_remove AS canRemove, sort_no AS sortNo, allergens FROM vw_menu_ing_json WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
SELECT policy_id AS policyId, policy_name AS policyName, min_select AS minSelect, max_select AS maxSelect, policy_required AS isRequired, items FROM vw_menu_opt_policy_json WHERE menu_id = #{menuId}
